newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy and corn drop, wheat steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy and corn drop, wheat steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn and soybean basis offers dropped on Friday while soft red winter and hard red winter wheat values remained steady.
Corn was weighed down by ideal growing weather in the Midwest Corn Belt.
"The weather is cooperative and it is going to be a good crop. We are also starting to see some movement," one U.S. exporter said.
Soybean FOB offers fell three cents a bushel, taking cues from the volatility of the July/August spread on the Chicago Board of Trade soybean futures, another dealer said.
